title: ChatGPT-assisted theater-management UML class diagram
summary: Second-year students prompt ChatGPT to create a UML class diagram from requirements for a theater and play management application. They iteratively improve the response, may correct it manually, and submit the conversation, final diagram, and an analysis of defects and revisions.

sources.title: Generative AI in the Software Modeling Classroom: An Experience Report with ChatGPT and Unified Modeling Language
sources.evidence_quote: Students were asked to obtain a class diagram for the application by entering a prompt.

assessment.summary: Use ChatGPT and PlantUML to model a theater-management application, then identify and repair defects in the generated diagram.
student_actions: Prompt ChatGPT from supplied application requirements.
Iterate and manually improve the class diagram.
Identify errors in entities, attributes, inheritance, associations, and multiplicities.

student_role.description: Students must generate and critically improve a ChatGPT class diagram.

grading.method: Instructors checked genuine effort and students' detection of errors in six UML element categories.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
